item.title: Tesla Just Beat Mazda: User Interface, Not Screen Size Influence Safe Vehicle Operation
item.description: Modern vehicles with their touchscreen heavy interfaces are bringing safety to the wrong direction. In a follow up to a 2022 test done by Swedish publication Vi Bilägare , they found that drivers now take longer to complete a set of common in-vehicle tasks than they did four years ago .
